jobs.description: Job opportunity: Senior Product Designer Skip to content ← All Jobs Senior Product Designer · Full-time · Senior About The Position ABOUT DRIIVZ Driivz builds the operating system for EV charging networks. Founded in 2013 and acquired by Vontier — a global leader in smart transportation. We're 200 people, mostly in Israel, operating in 30 countries with customers like Shell, Volvo, and leading electricity companies worldwide. Our platform has two sides: a powerful B2B web product for operators, and a white-label mobile app for the drivers using their chargers. Both sides are growing — and both need great design. The EV market is one of the fastest-growing in the world, and we're building the infrastructure that makes it work. THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the mobile domain at Driivz — the white-label iOS and Android apps used by EV drivers across 30 countries, as well as a new responsive driver web portal planned for the future. This is a mobile-led role. You'll own the full iOS and Android experience — from native patterns and onboarding flows to white-label configurations and consumer-grade polish. Alongside the mobile domain, you'll also contribute to our B2B operator platform, bringing your product thinking to a broader ecosystem. We're looking for someone who can grow with us as both sides of the product evolve. Beyond UX thinking, we're looking for a designer with a strong visual craft and artistic sensibility — someone who cares deeply about how things look, not just how they work. White-label mobile products live or die by their visual quality, and we want someone who can bring creativity, attention to detail, and aesthetic ambition to every screen they touch. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own end-to-end design for our white-label mobile apps (iOS and Android) — maintaining existing features, designing new flows, and ensuring quality across brand configurations Lead the redesign of the driver-facing responsive web portal — covering charger discovery, onboarding, session management, and payment flows Design within and contribute to our shared MUI-based design system, ensuring consistency across mobile and web experiences Collaborate with product managers and engineers across the team to define requirements, validate concepts, and ensure implementation accuracy Use AI tools actively in your workflow — and bring ideas for how AI can improve the driver experience Help establish design culture and process as we grow our India team Contribute to the B2B operator platform alongside the mobile domain — designing for both drivers and the operators who serve them WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 7+ years of product design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating native mobile app design (iOS and/or Android) Mastery of Figma — auto layout, components, variables, prototyping, and clean file organization Solid experience with MUI or similar component-based design systems Strong understanding of mobile design patterns, platform guidelines, and responsive web design Experience with B2B or complex SaaS products — you can design for both consumers and professionals Excellent written and spoken English — you'll be collaborating daily with worldwide teams across video calls, chats, and async feedback Self-managed and structured — you know how to operate independently in a remote, cross-timezone environment Genuine curiosity about AI tools and how they fit into your design process NICE TO HAVE Experience with white-label products — designing a system that supports multiple brand identities Background in designing AI-powered product features: prompts, outputs, confidence states, fallbacks, or AI onboarding flows Familiarity with Token Studio, Storybook, or design-to-code workflows Experience in mobility, transportation, fintech, or consumer-facing SaaS WHY DRIIVZ Real ownership — the mobile domain is yours to shape, not just maintain A product that matters — EV charging infrastructure is one of the most important design problems of the next decade A small, senior team — tight collaboration with experienced designers, PMs, and engineers who care about craft Room to grow — as we invest more in AI and platform design, there's a real path to expand your scope Apply for this position

We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that enables our clients to efficiently manage their networks and provide EV drivers with exceptional charging experience. Build and scale the backend systems behind EV charging at global scale - services handling hundreds of millions of events across 160,000+ chargers. Tackle real distributed-systems challenges: multi-tenant isolation, high-throughput event processing, and the performance demands of a live charging network. Requirements What should you have? jobs.description: Job opportunity: Head of Data & AI - India Skip to content ← All Jobs Head of Data & AI - India India · Full-time · Management About The Position The role As Head of Data & AI you will own Driivz's data platform and AI product layer end to end. You will report directly to the TBD and work closely with global commercial and customer success leadership. You are not a functional manager overseeing an analytics team. You are the technical and product owner of a new business line, responsible for both what gets built and what gets sold. The work spans the full stack: data infrastructure, machine learning, applied AI, and the commercial product layer that sits on top. The problems are genuinely hard -- multi-vendor hardware, real-time event streams at scale, complex energy market signals, and operators running critical public infrastructure that cannot tolerate errors. What you will own • Data platform architecture and delivery -- the foundation that everything else depends on • Machine learning and AI system design, from model training through to production operation • Real-time data ingestion and processing at scale across heterogeneous hardware and markets • All foundational technology decisions: stack, tooling, infrastructure approach • Production reliability of every system and model the team ships • AI product scope and packaging • Technical relationships with Driivz's most strategically important operator accounts • Data strategy and technology roadmap • teamwork with the CPO to define the art of the possible use cases Requirements What we are looking for • You have built a data or AI platform from 0 to 1 at a B2B SaaS or industrial technology company. • You have shipped AI systems that execute decisions or actions in production. • You have led a data or AI team across engineering and science disciplines. • You are technically deep and commercially aware. You can design a data architecture in the morning and have a credible commercial conversation with a senior operator in the afternoon. • You operate well under ambiguity. You are the person who turns the former into the latter. Strong signal • EV, energy, smart grid, or industrial IoT background or a clear track record of acquiring deep domain knowledge quickly in a new technical vertical • Production experience with agentic or autonomous AI including cost optimization and efficiency • Industrial or IoT protocol experience: OCPP, MQTT, or equivalent, high-frequency event streams from hardware at scale • Snowflake at production scale: schema design, real-time ingestion pipelines, ML integration, cost governance • Confidence calibration and threshold design for AI systems that operate without human approval on every decision • Effective cross-timezone leadership: comfortable building a high-performing team while operating as a daily peer to global commercial and CS leadership Apply for this position

jobs.title: Mobile Manual QA - India Other · Full-time · Senior
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Mobile Manual QA - India Skip to content ← All Jobs Mobile Manual QA - India · Full-time · Senior About The Position About the job Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV Charging and Energy Management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers. We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that enables our clients to efficiently manage their networks and provide EV drivers with an exceptional charging experience. Operating in over 35 countries across the US, Europe, and Asia, we enable hundreds of millions of events for millions of EV drivers and manage more than 160,000 public chargers (with 100,000s in roaming). Our customers include global industry leaders such as EVgo, Volvo Group, Shell, Circle K, Mer, Recharge, Kople, ESB, CEZ, MOL Group, ST1, and eMobility Power. Join our team to work alongside the most brilliant and disruptive minds focused on leading the eMobility industry and building a greener world. About the Role Are you naturally curious, sharp-eyed, and excited by the challenge of holding AI to a higher standard than the humans who built it? Do you treat test cases as a craft, AI-generated suggestions as drafts to be questioned, and the boundary between "looks right" and "is right" as the place your best work happens? If so, this role is for you. We're looking for the next generation of mobile tester — a Senior Manual QA Engineer who treats AI like a power tool, not a magic wand. You'll join our Mobile team to own quality across the Driivz mobile experience on Android, iOS, and the Driver Portal (Web). You'll work as a peer to our developers and PMs, sit at the table during PI-week QA scoping, and use Claude Code daily — but your judgement, not your prompts, will be the deliverable. Key Responsibilities QA Driivz Mobile EV features such as charging, site discovery, payments, biometrics, history, profile, notifications etc. — across Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift), and the Driver Portal web flows. Author and maintain Testmo cases per the Driivz Testing Guideline; link every case to its Jira story; keep Epic-level QA aggregate estimates honest. Participate in PI-week QA scoping : name your test types, environments, risk rating, and cross-flavour scope on every committed Epic (per the QA sub-gate criteria a–d). Review product specifications and identify test requirements before stories enter grooming. Validate AI-generated test artefacts — cases, scenarios, repro steps — and reject anything that doesn't survive critical review. Verify accessibility (TalkBack on Android, VoiceOver on iOS) and localisation (RTL, dates, currencies, numbers) on every shipped feature. Triage incoming bugs with clean repro, environment context, logs, and a justified severity. Partner with developers on risk-driven exploratory testing — the structured cases catch known unknowns; you find the unknown unknowns. Recommend improvements to product behaviour and user experience based on test findings. What we're looking for 4–7 years of hands-on mobile QA on shipped Android + iOS production apps. Strong native-platform awareness: Android API 24 → 34+ fragmentation, iOS 15+ background-refresh non-determinism, deep-link routing, push notifications, offline behaviour, biometric auth, lifecycle edge cases. Driver Portal / web QA experience — or a strong willingness to span. We don't split testers by platform; you cover the full driver journey. Multi-tenant / multi-flavour parametric testing. You don't write a case four times; you write it once and parametrise. Accessibility: TalkBack, VoiceOver, contrast ratios, touch-target sizing, keyboard navigation. Localisation: RTL handling, locale-dependent formatting. Risk-based test depth — you know when 30 cases is right and when 8 plus exploratory is right. Network conditioning (Charles or Proxyman); real-device labs and cloud labs (Firebase Test Lab, BrowserStack, or equivalent). Comfortable testing RESTful APIs and reading mobile network traces — both client- and server-side awareness. Bug triage with clean repro — steps, environment, logs, severity, blast radius. Strong analytical and root-cause skills under pressure. Excellent English communication, both verbal and written. Self-starter, quick learner, comfortable working independently across cross-functional teams. Tools you'll use Testmo · Jira · Confluence · Claude Code + the Driivz plugins · Android Studio · Xcode · Charles / Proxyman · Swagger · Firebase · Teams. AI-era skills we're hiring for (the differentiator) Fluent with Claude Code as a daily tool. Skills, agents, plugins, MCP servers — you use them to accelerate test design, generate edge cases from a spec, and pressure-test acceptance criteria. Authoring Testmo cases from a spec with AI scaffolding, then editing with judgement. You know that AI-generated cases are starting points , not deliverables. You read AI-generated spec analysis and feedback the Testing Guideline section that applies — shaping the downstream test-case generation before it runs. You spot AI failure modes — hallucinated steps, false coverage, plausible-but-wrong assertions, over-generic cases. You treat AI output like a junior engineer's PR: verify before merge. You know when NOT to use AI — security-sensitive flows, brand-critical UX moments, exploratory sessions where serendipity is the value, anything with regulatory exposure. You'll test code that AI developer agents authored and AI PR-reviewer agents approved — you know how these agents fail, which seams they get wrong, and where regression risk concentrates after AI-authored changes. You communicate in chain vocabulary — gates, contracts, state-transitions, Epics, stories. You think in graded handoffs, not just features. The bar isn't uses AI tools . The bar is judges AI output well . How we work Quality is a gate, not an inspection. We catch issues at PI-week QA scoping, in spec review, and at story decomposit

jobs.description: Job opportunity: Data & AI Product Manager - India Skip to content ← All Jobs Data & AI Product Manager - India · Full-time · Senior About The Position The role This role exists at the intersection of a technically complex AI system and a commercial market that is still learning what it will pay for. As Data and AI Product Manager you will define what Driivz's data and AI capabilities look like as products that operators buy -- the packaging, the pricing logic, the proof-of-value framework, and the commercial conversation that converts a pilot into a contract. You are not a scrum master and you are not a backlog prioritiser. You are the person who understands what operators will pay for before the team builds it, designs the commercial model that makes the product a business, and manages the pilot operators whose experience generates the proof points that make the next sale possible. You work from India but you spend significant time in commercial conversations with operators across multiple geographies. What you will own Product and commercial • AI product scope and packaging: what gets built into a discrete product that operators pay for, in what tiers, at what price points • Commercial model design: the pricing logic that connects the value Driivz generates for operators to a fee structure that is fair, credible, and scalable • Proof-of-value framework: the structure of pilot periods including baseline measurement, tracked metrics, and conversion logic -- the 90-day pilot must make the commercial decision obvious, not require a separate sales effort • Guardrail framework: translating operator preferences for AI decision boundaries into documented product configuration requirements for the engineering team Customer and market • Pilot operator management: running the proof periods of the first 3 to 5 operator pilots from connection to contract • Operator discovery: 5 or more structured discovery conversations per quarter with operator ops directors and commercial leadership -- understanding what they will pay for before building it • GTM with CS and commercial: translating AI system capabilities into the language and framing that closes a conversation with a CFO or COO • External operator pipeline: identifying and engaging operators outside Driivz's existing customer base who are candidates for standalone AI product adoption What we are looking for Non-negotiable • You have taken a data or AI product to market -- not internal tooling, not a feature within a larger product, but a discrete product that external customers evaluated, negotiated, and paid for. • You have designed a commercial model for a product where value is variable and outcome-linked. You understand the difference between value-based pricing and cost-plus pricing and can explain when each is appropriate. • You have run commercial discovery conversations at VP or C-suite level -- not just with product users or technical stakeholders. You understand how a CFO evaluates a data product differently from how an ops director does. • You can build a financial case from operational data. The commercial conversation for this product requires translating system performance metrics into an operator P&L impact that a CFO will accept. Strong signal • EV, energy, smart grid, infrastructure, or industrial IoT sector product experience • SLA-based or outcome-linked commercial model experience: contracts where payment depends on measured performance • Cross-geography commercial experience: operator conversations spanning different regulatory environments and commercial cultures • Technical credibility: able to explain what the AI system does without misrepresenting it -- CPOs ask hard questions and will not sign contracts with someone who does not understand the product • Proof period design: has structured a time-limited pilot that produced a clear, data-backed commercial decision at the end This role is not right for you if • You have only managed internal product roadmaps or feature backlogs. This role requires commercial ownership -- pricing decisions, contract terms, and the revenue that comes from signed contracts. • You have not had commercial conversations with CFO or COO-level buyers. The product conversation for AI systems that affect operational costs and revenues happens at a different level than typical product discovery. • You cannot explain the difference between a managed fee and a performance-based commercial model, or when each is the right choice for an operator in a specific situation. Apply for this position

jobs.title: VP Product Israel · Full-time · Senior
jobs.description: Job opportunity: VP Product Skip to content ← All Jobs VP Product Israel · Full-time · Senior About The Position WHO IS VONTIER Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies. Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry. With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment. Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future. Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally. Together, let's power the way the world moves! Driivz is the leading enterprise EV charging management platform (CPMS), powering 160,000+ chargers across 35 countries for operators including Shell, EVgo, ESB, and Circle K. This role owns the connective tissue between product strategy and product reality — turning direction set by the CPO into a roadmap the org can actually execute, and building the team that delivers it. The VP Product is the operating leader of the Product organization, reporting directly to the CPO. Where the CPO sets vision, strategy, and external direction (standards bodies, executive stakeholders, board-level priorities), the VP Product owns turning that strategy into a resourced, sequenced, well-specified roadmap — and building the org that ships it. This is a player-coach role: equal parts organizational leadership, cross-functional orchestration, and hands-on quality bar for what 'good' looks like in a spec, a UX flow, or a release. You will sit above Driivz's two Product Management clusters (Connectivity — charger management, roaming, energy & grid; and Commercial — billing, driver & B2B, fleet), as well as UX and Technical Writing, giving you end-to-end ownership of how product intent becomes shipped, documented, well-designed product. This role is deliberately set at VP level to give you real seniority parity with senior Engineering leadership — you are the day-to-day operating counterpart who turns strategy into shipped product together, roadmap to build, sprint to sprint. Key Responsibilities: Team Building & Leadership • Rebuild and scale a Product org recently restructured into two PM clusters (Connectivity, Commercial) plus UX and Technical Writing — hire, develop, and retain team leads and ICs. • Own performance management, career growth, and succession planning for PM, UX, and Writing leads; identify and address flight risk before it becomes attrition. • Close open organizational gaps and ambiguous ownership areas with clear, durable decisions rather than leaving them unresolved. • Establish a consistent operating rhythm — planning cadence, roadmap reviews, cross-cluster syncs — that scales as the team grows. • Set and model the bar for product craft: what a good spec, a good roadmap bet, and a good release readiness review look like. Strategy to Roadmap to Shipped Product • Translate CPO-level strategy into a prioritized, resourced roadmap across both PM clusters. • Own the mechanics of prioritization — balancing enterprise customer commitments, platform investment, and longer-term strategic bets. • Drive roadmap-to-delivery accountability: planned-vs-actual tracking, planning quality, and closing the loop when estimates or scope drift. • Partner directly with Engineering leadership as day-to-day operating counterpart — joint ownership of sequencing, tradeoffs, and ensuring roadmap commitments are realistic against true engineering dependencies. • Ensure UX and Technical Writing are embedded early in the roadmap process, not bolted on at the end — design and documentation debt should never be a release surprise. Cross-Functional & Executive Operating • Represent the Product organization in executive and cross-company forums, deputizing for the CPO where appropriate. • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and enterprise CPO stakeholders to translate customer and RFP commitments into roadmap reality. • Own the interface between Product and Data & AI, Platform, and Commercial leadership to ensure roadmap decisions reflect real technical and commercial constraints. • Bring visibility and rigor to reporting — status, risk, and tradeoffs — so the CPO and executive team can make fast, well-informed calls. What Success Looks Like • A fully staffed, low-attrition Product org with clear ownership across every function — no ambiguous reporting lines, no unfilled critical roles. • A roadmap that is trusted: what's committed gets delivered, and when it doesn't, the team knows why fast. • UX and Technical Writing operating as full roadmap partners, not downstream service functions. • PM leads who are growing into stronger operators themselves — this role scales through the team, not around it. • Strong, trusted working relationships across R&D, Sales, a
